sloka: नाहं विराधो विज्ञेयो न कबन्धः खरो न च।न वाली न च मारीचः कुम्भकर्णो ऽहमागतः ।। ६.६७.१३६ ।।
transliteration: nāhaṁ virādho vijñeyo na kabandhaḥ kharo na ca।na vālī na ca mārīcaḥ kumbhakarṇo 'hamāgataḥ ।। 6.67.136 ।।

translations.english: Raghava's eyes turned red with anger, went quickly in anger as monkeys and troop leaders oppressed by Kumbhakarna were rejoiced.
